statement:
∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ),
  DifferentiableOn ℂ F {1}ᶜ →
    (∀ (z : ℂ), ‖z‖ < 1 → HasSum (fun n => z ^ n) (F z)) → ∀ (z : ℂ), z ≠ 1 → F z * (1 - z) = 1
